title: Elements of a ring glue uniquely along a standard open covering
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $f_1,\dots,f_r\in R$ elements generating the unit ideal; for $i,j$ let $R_{f_i}\to R_{f_if_j}$ and $R_{f_j}\to R_{f_if_j}$ be the canonical maps of localizations [def-weil-ring-localization-away] ($x/f_i^e\mapsto f_j^ex/(f_if_j)^e$). (i) If $x\in R$ has $x/1=0$ in $R_{f_i}$ for every $i$, then $x=0$. (ii) If $x_i\in R_{f_i}$ ($i=1,\dots,r$) are such that $x_i$ and $x_j$ have the same image in $R_{f_if_j}$ for all $i,j$, then there is exactly one $x\in R$ with $x/1=x_i$ in $R_{f_i}$ for every $i$.
